notes.description: Round 1: compare the rest of the spec with the owner's request and accepted amendments before building. Later turns: re-check the current implementation. Quote every narrowed requirement and ask about each gap in questions; for unclear say why and what would settle it.

summary.description: What you changed in this turn and why, in a few sentences; say plainly what is not done yet.

tests.description: The commands you ran to verify the work and their outcome; "not run" with the reason if you could not run them.

responses.description: One entry per review issue listed in the prompt; empty in the first turn.

id.description: The issue id from the review, e.g. C1.

action.description: fixed = changed on disk; disputed = the issue does not hold (give evidence); needs-user = the owner has to decide.

note.description: What changed and where (path:line), or the evidence for a dispute.

questions.description: Open questions for the architect or the owner; empty if none.
